notes.title: Demo 1.1.2 Update - French Language
notes.notes:
Hello again !

Ruby Journey is now [i]disponible en francais ![/i]

I also made the ingame panels (trade, minimap, pnj interaction...) smoother (easing is now cubic and not linear).

Feel free to wishlist the game, hop into our Discord, and enjoy!

notes.title: Demo 1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
After testing, I estimate the demo to be more like 1-2h long.

Whatever, minor changes include new footsteps, visual details (such as better y sorting for tools), etc.

To french people: A french-speaking livestream is planned at Saturday 10th, 19h, in my YouTube channel (@aizeir).
Some french and english speaking livestreams may occur in the future.

Have fun !!! 😉

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
The demo is now [b]30min-1h gameplay[/b], with 3 maps.
[i](4 maps if we count the player house...)[/i]

There may be lots of bugfixes and adjustments that should be done in the future.

Have fun !!! 😁
